maintenance: Manually maintained once per year. Entries with status 'confirmed' carry an agency-announced date. Entries with status 'rule' state the agency's publication rule only; the exact date must be copied from the cited authoritative schedule before the entry is promoted to 'confirmed'. A rule entry is never used to infer an exact release date.
